people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
translations.bsb: So the LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and many of the Israelites were bitten and died.
translations.kjv: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
translations.asv: And Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
